findings.summary: Valid TOML table headers with trailing comments are rejected.
findings.evidence: readConfig requires a header line to end with ']' at lines 82-86. Standard TOML such as '[say] # settings' is rejected as an invalid table header.
findings.requirement: FD Work Item 1.3 requires TOML parsing; Acceptance requires install configuration to set translation options.
findings.requested_change: Strip/parse TOML comments correctly on table headers and verify a valid commented header loads its settings.
